thread:
Aisha (Product PM): ACME wants a sprint-slot allocator that prefetches tenant model weights + KV prefixes to cut cold-start tails. They expect Q3. Need quick cross-team alignment (runtime/infra/security + eng).
Dan (Eng): clarifying q: per-tenant opt-in or global?
Aisha (Product PM): per-tenant opt-in for pilot. Goals: reduce target-tenant cold-start p95, keep baseline p95 same for others, cost delta <=8%.
Priya (Runtime): two runtime risks: memory/KV eviction if many tenants warmed; scheduling prefetch must not hurt live batching. Propose a prefetch queue that runs in off-peak windows and sets a warmed TTL flag.
Jorge (Infra): infra needs GPU-minute estimates and whether we need ephemeral storage. New SKU provisioning takes ~48h. I'll open capacity ticket and try to use existing pools first.
Lena (Security): since caches are ephemeral, main needs are opt-in audit events and a brief security review. If KMS used, ensure rate limits + audit.
Aisha (Product PM): proposed plan: 0-2w spike (runtime+infra), week 3 internal canary (5 tenants), week 4-5 monitor, week 6 customer pilot.
Priya (Runtime): runtime acceptance: warm path reduces cold-start p95 by >=40% on tests; peak overhead <5%; quick rollback via feature flag that drains queue. We'll add metrics: prefetch_tasks_pending, warmed_tenants_count, prefetch_gpu_mins.
Dan (Eng): test plan: tenant replay + warm/unwarm cycles; canary alerting: prefetch_fail_rate >1% or warmed_tenant_errors -> rollback.
Lena (Security): I'll schedule a 1h review; need opt-in event schema and PR pointer.
Aisha (Product PM): please reply with "ack" + estimate (hrs) by EOD so I can lock roadmap.
Dan (Eng): ack 32h.
Priya (Runtime): ack 48h.
Jorge (Infra): ack 16h (+48h if new SKUs).
Lena (Security): ack 6h.
Aisha (Product PM): thanks everyone, I'll draft the spec and add to Q3 slate. :rocket:
